typography.instructions: Never use Inter for headings. Keep letter-spacing tight on headings. Use tabular-nums for BOM quantities, Material IDs, and ECOs to align perfectly.

colors.instructions: No full-screen gradients. Use solid stark colors. Emphasize high contrast for readability. FORBIDDEN: teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4). Tinted greys only.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton, make the grid visible. 1px subtle borders (border-border/40) for tables and stats containers.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalist. Use micro-interactions for feedback. Hover state lift on rows (bg-muted). Subtle pulse (animate-pulse) for the live SAP connection dot indicator.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas, use Flat Solid backgrounds for tables to prevent visual refraction of dense BOM data.

custom_instructions: Use Shadcn components for structural logic but apply custom tailwind styling.
Card/Containers: Flat background, sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 4px radius), 1px border, no heavy drop shadows.
Table: Dense spacing (py-2 px-3 cells), distinct borders for scanning massive BOM hierarchies.
Toast: Use Sonner for SAP API success/error feedback.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) for dashboard context.
layouts.spacing: Tight inside data widgets (gap-4). Generous padding around the main app container (p-8 or p-12).
structure: Header: BOM Search Bar (wide) + Connection Status Indicator (right aligned)
Stats Section: 4-column dense grid (Bento Mode B) for summary metrics (Total Components, Total Groups, Active Materials, Last Synced)
Main Content: Full width Table displaying the hierarchical BOM (Group > Line Item > Material > Quantity > UOM > ECO > Active)

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard or minimum WCAG AA. Text on status badges MUST meet 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast, e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (search input, submit button, active status toggles/badges) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

icons.style: Use Regular or Duotone weight to maintain technical precision for ERP data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React (JavaScript, not TSX) interface that mimics an elite, technical command center for SAP Business ByDesign.
Do NOT use raw HTML inputs or selects; always use Shadcn Input, Button, etc.
Maintain raw data integrity: always use the monospace font family for IDs and Quantities.
Implement a robust 'mock' of the SAP BOM API call if the FastAPI backend is not yet attached. Simulate loading (skeletons) and potential error states to demonstrate UI resilience.
Delete default App-logo logic and center-aligning styles from App.css. Enforce a top-left aligned, rigid grid flow.
Include a visible 'SAP Connected' vs 'SAP Disconnected' status indicator in the top right.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for layout separation. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
